name: Shinomori Yomogi
source:
A third-year student at Kiyama Academy and the dormitory head of Kiyama Dormitory, she is a senpai.

Perhaps thanks to the elite education given by her mother, who is a lawyer, her mind works incredibly fast.

A natural genius, she understands and never forgets anything she sees or hears even once, and she consistently keeps a tie for first place in her grade on the academy’s regular exams.

She is the manager of Café Arte and, at the same time, its sole remaining employee.

Since running Arte by herself was understandably impossible, she had been thinking of closing the shop. However, after a fateful encounter with Shuusuke, she ends up working together with him to rebuild Arte.
